distribution: PyPI wheel cctbx-base, the maintained standalone MolProbity runtime; the classic phenix.molprobity command needs the commercial Phenix build and is not used
model_terms: MolProbity validation uses no trained model or checkpoint. It does require reference data: the Top8000 rotamer/Ramachandran contour tables and a chemical-component restraint dictionary. Those data are provisioned separately and recorded in MODEL_ASSETS.md.
embedded_validation_backends: The open-source wheel runs clash detection through the bundled mmtbx.probe C++ extension (Apache-2.0, preserved at /opt/molprobity/probe-LICENSE.txt) and hydrogen placement through mmtbx.reduce; the external Duke probe/reduce binaries and the phenix.molprobity driver are not installed and are not used.
